name: Reference Extravaganza
description: Supercharge Thymer references, Roam-style. Bare left-click on a line-reference chip opens its action menu with asynchronously hydrated Block Context above immediately available actions; right-click opens the same menu. custom.lineRefClickContext accepts absent/true/"menu" (default menu with context), "popover" (standalone context), or false/"off" (plain menu). Durable record and line aliases let [[ and (( resolve multiple alternative names to stable GUIDs, with explicit management and no ambiguity guessing. Type (( to reference any line of text inline (Roam block refs: search, pick, insert) and [[ to reference a page by name (the chip renders the page's live name; Enter creates a missing page in Notes, with the workspace default as fallback). "Copy reference to current line" / "Paste reference" replicate Roam's copy-block-ref flow. Set an alias on any reference, page or line, to change what its chip shows without recreating the link: the box pre-fills with the current title so you can trim it down. Inline Preview: Cmd/Ctrl+Down opens line references as native editable transclusions; only a target subtree above 1,500 lines stays in an instant 40-row native-backed outline with Edit selected and an explicit Load complete inline — may be slow action. Page references use lightweight persisted editable property previews; choose Load full body to explicitly mount a page's complete native body. Image and file lines render meaningful local-blob cards; raster images settle lazily and PDFs load only on explicit preview. Cmd/Ctrl+Up collapses either form. Many previews stay open across reload and remain keyboard-navigable (press Down from a reference to arrow through its properties or actions). Commands: "Set alias for reference" (shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+A, rebindable via "Set alias keyboard shortcut"), "Collapse all embeds (this page)". Set custom.lineRefTrigger / custom.pageRefTrigger = false to disable either trigger. Clicking a reference-count badge toggles an inline 'N Linked References' section directly under the line (Roam's count-click): grouped by source page, full-context rows (breadcrumb, full line, children), filter box, editable in place; Shift+click keeps the floating popover, Alt+click still instant-embeds (swap the plain/Shift roles with custom.counter.clickAction = 'popover'). Lines that are themselves referenced get a subtle count pill at the line's end (Roam outline counts) — click it to expand that line's inbound references inline; disable with custom.counter.targetLineBadges = false. PIN an inline section (📌 in its header) to make it persist: a pinned 'all references to X, right here' block reopens on every load — Roam's {{mentions}} with zero document lines (the pin is stored as meta on the host line; collapsing a pinned section unpins it). REFERENCE WORKBENCH — NATIVELY EDITABLE (Roam's right sidebar, full port): run "Open Reference Workbench" for a rightmost side panel holding a stacked shelf of collected pages, lines, AND linked-references views. Collect via Shift+click on any reference chip or page link, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+O with the caret on a reference (custom.sidebarChord = 'panel' restores the native-side-panel chord), the reference menu's "Add to Workbench - Reference" / "Add to Workbench - Linked references" rows, the ⧉ in an inline section header, or the "Add current line/page to Workbench" palette commands — the panel opens itself when something lands on it. Every item opens as a real Thymer transclusion, so you click in and TYPE, add children, check tasks, edit properties — all saved to source, like Roam's editable sidebar (backed by a 'Reference Workbench State' record's body — one transclusion line per item — so order/content sync natively across your devices). A per-item header carries collapse / 📍 pin (new items open below pinned ones) / ⋯ view-as (Full editable · Children · Card · Linked refs) / ⇱ swap-to-main / ✕ remove. Filter box + count + Clear-all at the top. CHECKABLE TASK REFERENCES (Roam behavior): a reference to a task line renders a real checkbox you can CLICK — on the chip itself, in inline linked-reference rows, the count popover, and the Workbench — and it toggles the SOURCE task's status; task lines also show ☐/☑ in the (( picker rows. LINE-GUID PROPERTIES AS REFERENCES (opt-in, additive): set custom.lineRefProperties (default ["Source Line"]) to a list of property names whose LINE-guid value refx treats as a reference TO that line — so a source line whose guid is stored in, e.g., an org-remark Remark's "Source Line" property shows the count badge and lists the referencing records in its Linked References (a clean body on the comment, a clean source doc, the ref living in the property). Set it to [] or false to disable (zero cost, and the native line-ref / property-ref paths are unchanged).
